title: GothamChess vs The World
post: 225,000 people played ONE game of chess against GothamChess... and lost. Levy Rozman vs The World on Chess.com, 2025 — the Caro-Kann, the rook sacrifice and checkmate on move 41. #chess #gothamchess #levyrozman #chesstok #sacrificetherook

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: 225,000 people played one game of chess against one guy.
phrases.say: [excited] Two hundred twenty-five thousand people played one game of chess... against ONE guy.

phrases.text: This is Levy Rozman. GothamChess. The biggest chess channel on YouTube.
phrases.say: This is Levy Rozman. GothamChess. The biggest chess channel on YouTube.

phrases.text: Chess.com let the whole world vote on every move. One move a day.
phrases.say: Chess.com let the whole world vote on every move. One move a day.

phrases.text: In two days it smashed Magnus Carlsen's record.
phrases.say: [impressed] In two days it smashed Magnus Carlsen's record.

phrases.text: Levy took Black and played the Caro-Kann. His favorite opening, of course.
phrases.say: Levy took Black... and played the Caro-Kann. [laughs] His favorite opening, of course.

phrases.text: Then Levy parked his rook on h5. Right out in the open.
phrases.say: Then Levy parked his rook on h5. Right out in the open.

phrases.text: The World attacked it with a pawn. And Levy just ignored it.
phrases.say: The World attacked it with a pawn... [whispers] and Levy just ignored it.

phrases.text: Of course, the World took it.
phrases.say: [deadpan] Of course... the World took it.

phrases.text: Queen check. Knight to f4. Mate on g2 is coming, so the World has to give up its queen.
phrases.say: [excited] Queen check. Knight to f4. Mate on g2 is coming, so the World has to give up its queen!

phrases.text: Then Levy chased the king from g1 all the way across the board. Like a lion chasing its prey, he said.
phrases.say: Then Levy chased the king from g1... all the way across the board. Like a lion chasing its prey, he said.
Move forty-one. Rook takes a2. [shouting] Checkmate!

phrases.text: One YouTuber. 225,000 people. GothamChess one, the World zero.
phrases.say: One YouTuber. Two hundred twenty-five thousand people. [laughs] GothamChess one... the World zero.

phrases.text: Follow for more chess stories like this.
phrases.say: Follow for more chess stories like this.
